storage_note: Photon and event scalars are stored in ROOT TTrees when available. The compact readout_arrivals.json stores only detector-owned in-window arrival times and response outcomes; PNG plots are separate files in this directory.

notes: Photon count is fixed by the requested Monte Carlo sample size; it is not a Poisson draw from total_yield.
Rayleigh scattering is approximated as isotropic redistribution inside the active solid material.
The detector +x face uses detector_index for Fresnel transmission when the active solid has a planar +x portal; other faces use the external air interface.
Detector QE and collection efficiency apply only after interface transmission; QE=1 does not overcome total internal reflection.
The opposite -x end face mode is mirror.
t=0 is the instant the particle crosses the active solid entry surface; +z is the forward beam direction.
Active compound: section 0 box/fused_silica; section 1 tapered_rectangular_prism/fused_silica. Internal interfaces use local Fresnel/Snell transport.
